judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant aerial cloudscape with nice puffy texture, but the harsh sun glare and flare keep it from being more than a decent sky snapshot.
strengths: Textured, puffy cloud deck with good shadow depth
Layered thin cirrus above adds interest
Strong sense of altitude and vastness
weaknesses: Blown-out sun and lens flare dominate the upper left
Flat midtone contrast in the cloud field
